==Enemies==
'''Ghost''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Ghost]], a hidden enemy that first appears on Wave 8 in [[Pizza Party]]
**[[Ghost/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Ghost Knight]], a hidden and ghost enemy from the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]
*[[Ghost (Lunar Overture)]], a hidden enemy that first appeared on Wave 5 in the first act of [[Lunar Overture Event]] and Wave 4 of the second act of [[Lunar Overture Event]]
*[[Ghost (Nightmare Carnival)]], a hidden enemy that first appeared on Wave 9 in the [[Halloween 2019 Event]]
*[[Ghost (Solar Eclipse)]], a hidden and ghost enemy that first appeared on Wave 5 in the first and second night of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]
*[[Ghost (Trick or Threat Town)]], a hidden and ghost enemy that first appeared on Wave 6 in the [[Halloween 2020 Event]]
